why: P1 from an external audit, reproduced before fixing: with `scripts.test` defined and a workflow that only does `echo ok`, the rule failed -- and adding the line `# TODO: run test later` flipped the verdict to PASSED, exit 0. The base text was the raw YAML, so the word anywhere in the file satisfied the rule. The fail side has exactly that tree: a comment citing test, a job named test, and an `echo "running tests"` -- the three neighbors the report names together, and none of them executes anything. The pass side has all THREE too, plus a real `run: npm test`: it is the proof that the fix was not taking the word out of the text, but looking only where the workflow executes. Whoever swaps `comandosDoCi` for a subtraction of comments turns the fail side green again by the job name.
